title: A Storm on Jupiter Has Raged for 300 Years at 270 mph

scenes.text: One storm on Jupiter has raged for over 300 years.
It's called the Great Red Spot, and astronomers first recorded it in the 1600s.
Winds inside it reach about 270 miles per hour.
In 1999 it measured 15,400 miles across, almost twice as wide as Earth.
It has no ground to slow it down, so the storm just keeps spinning.
A storm older than America, and it's still going.

description:
One storm on Jupiter has raged for more than 300 years.
The Great Red Spot has winds near 270 miles per hour, and in 1999 it was almost twice as wide as Earth.
What would you name it?
first_comment: Winds of 270 mph for 300 years. Would you fly a probe into it?
